title: Micro Economics Theory II
modules: General Equilibrium In Production And Exchange
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the network of communications between individuals and firms for the purpose of buying and selling goods and services."
A market is the network of communications between individuals and firms for the purpose of buying and selling goods and services.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sum of all private economic costs of the firm that vary with its short-run level of output."
Total Variable Cost (TVC) is the sum of all private economic costs of the firm that vary with its short-run level of output.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to produce product Y, isoquant Ys can be attained."
Ifall of these inputs are used to produce product Y, isoquant Ys can be attained.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a plot of the budget equation for the two-input case."
An isocost line is a plot of the budget equation for the two-input case.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the expansion path for the ratio of input prices reflected by the slope of the isocost lines shown in the diagram."
The path ABCDE is the expansion path for the ratio of input prices reflected by the slope of the isocost lines shown in the diagram.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statement relating how inputs can be combined to achieve various possible levels of output."
A production function is a statement relating how inputs can be combined to achieve various possible levels of output.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the highest possible for this total product curve at point C. value, there is a point of diminishing average returns on the total product curve."
Finally AP is the highest possible for this total product curve at point C. value, there is a point of diminishing average returns on the total product curve.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called a terms outrace line and can be used to show what exchange of goods between the two consumers will lead them to equilibrium on the contract curve."
Line TT' is called a terms outrace line and can be used to show what exchange of goods between the two consumers will lead them to equilibrium on the contract curve.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a position that cannot be altered without making someone worse off."
A Pareto optimum is a position that cannot be altered without making someone worse off.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a table depicting the quantity demanded of a product over a given time period at various prices."
A demand schedule is a table depicting the quantity demanded of a product over a given time period at various prices.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the contract curve, which passes through all points where X and Y isoquants are tangent to each other."
The broken line is the contract curve, which passes through all points where X and Y isoquants are tangent to each other.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a contour line on a production surface."
An isoquant is a contour line on a production surface.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sunk cost and does not affect the retention decision."
The bonus is a sunk cost and does not affect the retention decision.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the amount (number of units) of a product that an individual would buy in a given period if it could buy all it wanted at the current market price."
Quantity demanded of a product is the amount (number of units) of a product that an individual would buy in a given period if it could buy all it wanted at the current market price.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the private economic cost of the firm's axed inputs in the short run."
Total cost is the private economic cost of the firm's axed inputs in the short run.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the concept that provides such information."
Short-run marginal cost is the concept that provides such information.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those costs of production that involve a payment by the firm to some person, group, or organization outside the firm."
Explicit costs are those costs of production that involve a payment by the firm to some person, group, or organization outside the firm.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fixed cost per uit of output."
Average fixed cost is the fixed cost per uit of output.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the costs of using firm-owned resources."
Implicit costs are the costs of using firm-owned resources.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tax or levy assessed on a particular product such as liquor or cigarette."
An excise tax is a tax or levy assessed on a particular product such as liquor or cigarette.
fib: ______ is the relationship between the quantity of a product that consumers are willing and able to buy over some given period and its price, other things remaining the same.
Demand
Demand is the relationship between the quantity of a product that consumers are willing and able to buy over some given period and its price, other things remaining the same.
______ is the path of tangencies between isoquants and isocost lines for a given input price ratio.
Expansion Path
The Expansion Path is the path of tangencies between isoquants and isocost lines for a given input price ratio.
______ is a period of time in which all of the inputs in a given production function can be changed in amount.
long run
The long run is a period of time in which all of the inputs in a given production function can be changed in amount.
______ is an important concept because it says what we can expect to get from employing an additional unit of an input.
Marginal product
Marginal product is an important concept because it says what we can expect to get from employing an additional unit of an input.
______ is the rate of change of long-run total cost with respect to changes in the quantity of output.
Long-run marginal cost
Long-run marginal cost is the rate of change of long-run total cost with respect to changes in the quantity of output.
______ is the return to entrepreneurs (owners, investors) that is necessary to keep the firm in operation over the long run.
normal profit
A normal profit is the return to entrepreneurs (owners, investors) that is necessary to keep the firm in operation over the long run.
______ is the rate of change of long-run total cost as output changes.
Long-run marginal cost (LMC)
Long-run marginal cost
LMC
Long-run marginal cost (LMC) is the rate of change of long-run total cost as output changes.
______ are the total obligations of the firm per time period for all fixed inputs.
Total fixed costs (TFC)
Total fixed costs
TFC
Total fixed costs (TFC) are the total obligations of the firm per time period for all fixed inputs.
______ is the tendency for supply and demand to equilibrate (i.e., for the price to move to the clearing level), so that there is neither excess demand nor supply.
market mechanism
The Market Mechanism The market mechanism is the tendency for supply and demand to equilibrate (i.e., for the price to move to the clearing level), so that there is neither excess demand nor supply.
______ refer to cost as something other than money in the course of obtaining a value.
economists
The economists refer to cost as something other than money in the course of obtaining a value.
______ is the minimum economic cost of producing each possible level of output when the time period is sufficiently long to change all inputs of the firm's production function.
Long-run total cost
Long-run total cost is the minimum economic cost of producing each possible level of output when the time period is sufficiently long to change all inputs of the firm's production function.
______ are responsible for the shape of a reshaped, long-run average cost curve.
Internal economies and diseconomies
Internal economies and diseconomies are responsible for the shape of a reshaped, long-run average cost curve.
______ is a graph describing how much of a goods a firm will sell at different prices.
Supply curve
Supply curve is a graph describing how much of a goods a firm will sell at different prices.
______ is the sum of all private economic costs of the firm that vary withits short-run level of output.
Total variable cost
Total variable cost is the sum of all private economic costs of the firm that vary withits short-run level of output.
______ is a plot of the minimum cost of production of each level of output,given the isoquant and isocost lines of panel (a).
LTC
The LTC is a plot of the minimum cost of production of each level of output,given the isoquant and isocost lines of panel (a).
______ is a more general concept that occurs when any change that benefits someone would result in harm for someone else (MRTS).
Economic efficiency
Economic efficiency is a more general concept that occurs when any change that benefits someone would result in harm for someone else (MRTS).
______ is the plant that has its SAC curve tangent to the LAC envelope curve at the minimum point of LAC.
optimum size plant
The optimum size plant is the plant that has its SAC curve tangent to the LAC envelope curve at the minimum point of LAC.
______ is a period of time in which at least one of the inputs in a firm's production function is totally fixed in amount, while one of more other inputs are variable.
short run
The short run is a period of time in which at least one of the inputs in a firm's production function is totally fixed in amount, while one of more other inputs are variable.
______ is a table showing how much of goods firms will sell at different prices.
Supply curve Supply schedule
Supply schedule Supply curve Supply schedule is a table showing how much of goods firms will sell at different prices.
______ is a plot of the combination of labou use and output level from panel (a).
total product curve
The total product curve is a plot of the combination of labou use and output level from panel (a).
